sources.entry: Hook for Mac - Link related files, emails, and notes for quick navigation.

summary.name: Hookmark
summary.one_liner: Hookmark is a Mac app for creating clean, shareable links to web pages, files, emails, and tasks, and for making two-way linked notes.
use_cases: Linking related files, emails, and tasks for one-click access
Creating two-way linked notes from a web page or PDF
Copying clean URLs without tracking clutter
Making file links that still work after moving a file
Revealing the current file in Finder
summary.what_it_does: Hookmark lets you copy links to web pages, files, emails, tasks, and other items from apps, then paste them elsewhere. It strips unnecessary cruft from URLs and works across browsers without extensions. The Hook to New command creates a named note in a chosen app with a two-way link back to the source. Pro features can create deep links to specific PDF locations and auto-bookmark to services such as Instapaper, GoodLinks, Pinboard, DEVONthink, and Linkding. Bookmarks are stored locally on the Mac.
notable: Hook to New creates a note with a two-way link to the source document
Cleans tracking cruft from URLs without browser extensions
Robust file links that keep working when files are moved or renamed
Deep links to specific PDF locations
caveats: Pro features require a paid upgrade after a 30-day trial
Basic features are free; no credit card required for basic use
Some features are limited to PDF apps and apps that support links
